name: DLX_SPRITE_SERIALIZED_HEADER_BYTES
evidence: Serialized entry construction copies ten bytes before setting the payload address to source+0Ah (clash95.asm:9376-9391); independent serializer writes 0Ah header bytes then serialized size minus 0Ah bytes from the payload (clash95.asm:9624-9631). Existing DLXSpriteView::kSerializedHeaderSize confirms this established naming domain.

name: DLX_SPRITE_PAYLOAD_HANDLE_BYTE_OFFSET
evidence: Borrowed constructor stores source+0Ah at object+0Ah (clash95.asm:9389-9391); independent destruction reads object+0Ah as the free argument (9494-9508), copy writes the allocation result at object+0Ah (9551-9564), and serializer reads object+0Ah as its payload source (9629). Existing DLXSpriteView::kPayloadHandleOffset and uint32_t access preserve the proven field identity.

name: DLX_SPRITE_SERIALIZED_SIZE_BYTE_OFFSET
evidence: Borrowed constructor stores the entry-size argument at object+0Eh (clash95.asm:9380); independent set serializer advances entry directory offsets by each object+0Eh (8917-8921), while sprite serializer subtracts header length from object+0Eh (9628-9630). Existing DLXSpriteView::kSerializedSizeOffset names the full serialized size, not payload-only bytes.

name: DLX_SPRITE_OWNS_PAYLOAD_BYTE_OFFSET
evidence: Borrowed constructor sets object+12h to zero (clash95.asm:9378), owning constructor and copy set it to one (9476,9553); independent destructor frees the payload only when that dword is nonzero (9494-9508). Existing DLXSpriteView::kOwnsPayloadOffset/ownsPayload confirms the established role.
